_about: Rules for article behavior that the game decides in code rather than data.
rivals2_move_boxes.py follows each article's own windows, velocity and gravity from the exported data;
add a rule here only when a move's frames are wrong because of game code (button release, an article already on stage, ...).
Keys are attack asset names (ATT_*). Each rule names the article asset (ART_*) and one of:
"switch": "<move window>"   when the move enters that window, the article jumps to "article_window"
"existing": "<move window>" the move drives an article already on stage: it appears when the move enters that
window, at "offset" (X ahead, Y up, game units) in "article_window"
Optional: "frame" (frames into the move window), "facing" (1 or -1), "note" (shown in info.md).

ATT_Abs_Fspecial.note: releasing special (Channeling -> Recovery) places the cloud; shown releasing after one Channeling loop

ATT_Abs_NspecialCloud.note: charging an existing cloud, assumed 300 ahead and 100 up
popping an existing cloud uncharged (special released during Charge), assumed 300 ahead and 100 up
